title: The Accept Stripe Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'href…
description: The Accept Stripe Payments plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 2.1.4 contains a stored DOM-based cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This flaw arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping of the 'href' attribute in <a> elements containing the 'asp_action=show_pp&product_id=' parameter. An unauthenticated attacker can inject malicious scripts that execute when a user accesses a page with the injected content. If the 'Prefetch Payment Popup Scripts' option is enabled, the script executes automatically on page load without user interaction.
